subject: SOC 2 evidence: MFA screenshots, log slices, access reviews & bridge letter
messages:
From: Marc Stone <marc.stone@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 — specific evidence requests for procurement

Vivek,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared earlier. Procurement ran a quick pass and we have a short list of items beyond the report that we need to close out security review before the pilot contract can be signed. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following artifacts (or equivalent explanations) by EOD next Wednesday (2026-08-19)?

1) MFA enforcement evidence — a small sample of user MFA configuration screenshots and an exported CSV that lists users with MFA status (only account IDs and status; PII can be redacted).
2) Auth/log slices — authentication/logging slices for the period 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-31 that show successful/failed logins (redact IPs if required). A single-day slice plus an aggregated count is fine for volume reasons.
3) Access review evidence — the most recent quarterly access review exports, reviewer names (or role), and remediation tickets.
4) SOC 2 bridge letter confirming continuity from the last audit period through our expected go-live (we expect a bridge that covers up to 2026-10-31).

Also a couple clarifying Qs: is the SOC 2 report scope inclusive of production shared GPUs and the console? And do you have an expected date for the next audit start?

If you need a secure transfer channel for logs, we can provide a temporary SFTP endpoint or a presigned bucket.

Appreciate it — these are gating items for our security committee.

Best,
Marc
Director, IT Risk & Security
Acme Health

[Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marc Stone <marc.stone@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 — specific evidence requests for procurement

Hi Marc,

Thanks — we can provide everything on your list. Quick responses inline: 

1) MFA enforcement evidence — yes. We can provide screenshots of admin policy and a CSV export showing user IDs and MFA status. We will redact PII and can hash account identifiers if preferred.

2) Auth/log slices — we can provide a single-day slice (14-Jul-2026) with event-level entries plus an aggregated summary for the full month. IP addresses can be redacted or truncated per your preference.

3) Access review evidence — we will export the Q2 access review report from the IAM system, including reviewer role and remediation ticket IDs.

4) Bridge letter — our legal team has a draft bridge letter that covers audit continuity to 2026-10-31; happy to route it for signature.

Scope answers: the SOC 2 Type II report covers the Redwood inference runtime and control plane used by hosted customers (includes production GPU pools and console). Next audit is scheduled to begin 2026-11-01.

Rishi and Laura — can you coordinate export and secure delivery? Marc — what's your preferred transfer method (SFTP or presigned bucket)?

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (PDF)]
